scope: Two decorative preview sites; directly necessary MUI Button/ButtonBase, sidebar pointer handlers, store setup and existing browser harness entry points only
executed: Read source and MUI installed implementation
Read existing browser harness and store/canvas setup

findings.actual: Decorative user-operation preview renders enabled MUI Button with pointerEvents:none, default native button and tabIndex0, no action handler. Text/variant/color derive actual config; real editing controls below use onChange and must remain interactive.

Active pointer-drag ghost renders enabled MUI Button with pointerEvents:none, default native button/tabIndex0. Real field card and document pointermove/up handlers own dragging; those must remain unchanged.

minimalCandidateAssessment.propOrder: Button forwards component and other props to ButtonBase. ButtonBase assigns non-native role=button into buttonProps, then spreads other after buttonProps; explicit presentation role overrides it. tabIndex=-1 is forwarded as disabled ? -1 : tabIndex.
minimalCandidateAssessment.style: Variant/color/size and sx remain in Button ownerState and styling classes. Component substitution changes DOM tag without setting disabled, preserving configured visual preview and text.
minimalCandidateAssessment.accessibilityScope: Removes native button and exposed button role and ordinary sequential Tab stop. It is not an absolute inert guarantee: tabindex=-1 elements can still receive intentional programmatic focus.
avoid: Only component=span still receives role=button by ButtonBase
disabled changes preview to disabled visual colors
aria-hidden alone would not remove tab stop
Do not change actual editing controls or actual field cards

adjacentCautions.observation: Legacy clone-based drag preview helper exists but has no call site in this component; current visible cards use draggable=false and onPointerDown. Do not expand this fix into dead-code cleanup.

Real card currently has onPointerDown only, not onClick/onKeyDown; cannot claim Enter/Space inserts a field from this source review. Broader non-drag alternative needs separate audit; this patch should test pointer drag remains usable.

recommendedBrowserHarness.workflow: Mount real WorkflowActionConfig in a small React state wrapper under real MUI ThemeProvider. kind=START, editable=true, initial defaultWorkflowButtons. Count/store actual onChange patches; update display name and style using real TextField/Select controls and verify preview updates. Scope preview via nearby user-operation-preview label or dedicated nonsemantic test marker.
recommendedBrowserHarness.sidebar: Mount real CanvasTab (tabs/canvas/CanvasTab.tsx) with real Zustand store, QueryClientProvider, SnackbarProvider, ThemeProvider. Seed real createEmptyTemplateDesignerDocument via store.setDocument, store.addField(text,label), store.setActiveCanvasRail(fields). This includes actual DesignerSidebar and CanvasSheetWorkspace drop listener, rather than a fake drop implementation.
recommendedBrowserHarness.ghost: Use real mouse pointer down on data-canvas-field-card, move at least4px while held, inspect data-canvas-field-drag-preview=true. Baseline should show BUTTON/tabIndex0; candidate SPAN/presentation/-1 with same label and CSS. Then move to actual data-sheet-cell-row/data-sheet-cell-col target and release; assert real store document contains field binding and source card availability reflects placement.
